components.css: .ds-field{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px;color:var(--ink,#20252b);font:500 13px Inter,sans-serif}.ds-field input{min-height:46px;padding:12px 14px;border:1px solid var(--line-strong,#7d8995);border-radius:10px;background:var(--surface,#edf0f3);color:var(--ink,#20252b);box-shadow:var(--inset,inset 3px 3px 7px #cdd5de,inset -3px -3px 7px #fff);font:400 14px Inter,sans-serif}.ds-field input:hover:not(:disabled){border-color:#58636e}.ds-field input:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--focus,#365976);outline-offset:2px}.ds-field input:disabled{box-shadow:none;color:var(--muted,#58636e);background:var(--surface-hover,#e3e8ed)}@media(max-width:760px){.ds-field input{font-size:16px}}

narrative.overview: NULL combines crisp Outline structure with the stronger neumorphic treatment approved by the user: pale gray material, charcoal type, raised surfaces, and inset controls. Financial information stays compact and legible, with generous gutters and clear next actions. Authentication, inbox, funds, dialogs, and settings share this light visual system. The current authority is soft-outline.css over the structural styles.css; docs/DESIGN_REFERENCE.md is historical.
keyCharacteristics: One pale material with a consistent upper-left light source.
Charcoal actions, clear field outlines, and readable semantic status labels.
Raised task panels and controls alongside flat financial tables.
The supplied six-blade aperture logo and restrained Inter typography.

rules.name: User-approved tactile depth
rules.body: The explicit Outline plus stronger Neumorphism direction is a deliberate exception to generic no-shadow defaults. Use shared raised and inset tokens with visible outlines and semantic states.

dos: Do extend Soft Outline across all routes and light Privy authentication.
Do preserve the six-blade currentColor logo and original black public/logo.svg.
Do preserve real balances, masking, recovery, visible focus, and reduced-motion behavior.
Do use flat financial tables and the full-width treasury with ledger beside the balance on desktop.
donts: Don't restore the dark Mercury palette or cobalt pill actions.
Don't rely on shadows alone for focus, controls, or status.
Don't invent balances, history, or unsupported privacy claims.
Don't treat simulated-session visual checks as live authentication or transaction verification.
